title: luzula multiflora var. frigida
intro: Luzula multiflora var. frigida, commonly known as Snowy Woodrush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Juncaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
